visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view shows a man's hands holding a silver knife against a rapidly rotating green abrasive belt on a black machine. The setting is a workshop with a green cutting mat. His left hand with a gold watch stabilizes the tool while the machine whirrs loudly. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a man in a black t-shirt standing in front of a window. He holds a gray belt sander, gesturing enthusiastically while explaining its features. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his facial expressions and the details of the device. (3) He holds up an older, handheld Work Sharp machine in his left hand and the new machine components in his right, comparing their sizes and designs. The background shows organized storage boxes and studio equipment, creating a professional yet casual DIY atmosphere. (4) The camera focuses on the power supply area where he connects a cable and shows a large 18V battery pack. His hands move precisely to demonstrate the versatility of the power options, pointing out the specific ports on the back of the device. (5) A tight close-up shows the KOMAX logo and the control interface. The man toggles a black switch to show the forward and reverse rotation of the belt, then rotates a circular dial to adjust the motor speed, demonstrating the machine's mechanical response. (6) He demonstrates the internal assembly by pressing a tension spring with his thumb, showing how to replace the sanding belt. The camera captures the metallic components and the textured surface of the belt in high detail as he explains the maintenance process. (7) He shows the fixed-angle guide plate, resting a knife on it to explain how to maintain a consistent 17-degree edge. His fingers point to the contact point between the blade and the belt, emphasizing the precision required for sharpening different types of knives. (8) The man attaches a thick, white cloth polishing wheel to the side of the machine. He applies a green compound to the wheel, explaining the final honing stage. The visual focus is on the circular motion of the wheel and the application of the polishing paste. (9) He performs a final sharpening test using a CAMPFIRE branded straight knife. He carefully draws the blade across the belt while maintaining a steady hand. The lighting reflects off the polished edge of the steel, showing the progress of the sharpening. (10) To demonstrate the sharpness, he holds the knife and slices through a thick stack of paper sheets. Each cut is smooth and effortless, with the paper curling away. He smiles at the camera, indicating satisfaction with the performance of the new belt sander.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with the loud, high-pitched whirring of an electric motor, followed by the abrasive grinding sound of metal against sandpaper. The spectral density is high in the upper-mid frequencies. There is no speech initially, only the raw sound of the machine. (2) A man begins speaking in a friendly, conversational Mandarin tone with moderate pitch and clear articulation. Simultaneously, a bright, rhythmic acoustic pop BGM starts at a low volume. The music has a steady tempo with light percussion and guitar. (3) As he demonstrates the machine's features, the audio includes sharp, mechanical clicks from flipping a toggle switch and the percussive thud of a battery pack being inserted. The speech remains consistent in volume and energy, showing high confidence. (4) The motor's whirring pitch rises and falls significantly as he adjusts the speed dial, ranging from a low hum to a piercing high-frequency whine. This technical sound clearly demonstrates the machine's variable RPM capabilities through acoustic feedback. (5) During the sharpening demonstration, the sound of metal friction becomes prominent again, occurring in rhythmic strokes. The grinding sound of the blade on the belt is accompanied by his continued explanation, with the BGM providing a constant, cheerful emotional bed. (6) The final phase features the distinct, crisp, high-frequency slicing and crinkle sounds of a sharp knife cutting through paper. These transients are very sharp and clear against the background music, providing auditory proof of the tool's effectiveness before the audio fades.
